transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've been feeling persistently depressed, sad, and just completely empty inside for a very long time now. This constant low mood has been going on for about two years and five months. I just don't know how to cope with it anymore.
During these past two years and five months, have there been any stretches of two months or longer when you felt mostly okay, or has the depression been there nearly every day the whole time?

No, I haven't had any breaks where I felt okay, not even for a month or two. This low mood, sadness, and lack of energy have been with me almost every single day for the entire two years and five months.

During this time, have there been periods of at least two weeks when your depression got noticeably worse and you also had several other symptoms like loss of interest, sleep or appetite changes, trouble concentrating, guilt, or thoughts of death?

No, it hasn't really come in distinct, much worse episodes like that. My low mood has just been a constant, steady struggle for the past two and a half years. I haven't really noticed any specific two-week periods where things suddenly got worse.

Along with the low mood, have you had at least two of these most days for the past two years: poor appetite or overeating, insomnia or sleeping too much, low energy, low self-esteem, poor concentration, or feeling hopeless?

Yes, for the past two and a half years, I have definitely struggled with sleep issues—both having trouble sleeping and sleeping too much—along with a constant lack of energy and fatigue. I don't really experience the other things you mentioned, like appetite changes, low self-esteem, or poor concentration. It's mostly just been the exhaustion and sleep problems alongside my low mood.
